book.title: The Holy Bible: English Standard Version
book.description:
Now the complete ESV Bible comes alive in audio format! The new ESV Hear the Word Audio Bible provides more than 75 hours of Bible reading, conveniently captured on 7 MP3 discs for listening at home, in your car, or for loading on an MP3 player. Each disc is fully searchable, helping you easily locate the exact Bible chapter you are looking for. Packaged in a sturdy zipper pack, the ESV Hear the Word Audio Bible is ideal for busy commuters, people on the go, and for the visually impaired-anyone who prefers to listen to as well as read the Bible.


Free ESV Bible Resources software offer included Contains the full 2011 ESV Bible text edition
